description: This file defines the EmailSettingsDisplayDriver class, which manages the display and editing of email settings within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It handles authorization, rendering the settings UI, updating settings, and retrieving email provider options.

classes.name: EmailSettingsDisplayDriver
classes.description: A driver class for displaying and editing email settings within OrchardCore, handling authorization, rendering, and updating email provider configurations.

methods.name: EmailSettingsDisplayDriver
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for email settings display driver.

methods.name: EditAsync
methods.description: Handles rendering the email settings edit UI, with authorization check.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Processes updates to email settings, with authorization check and release request if provider changes.

methods.name: GetProviderOptionsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves enabled email provider options for selection.
